A dramatic scene on a wooden ship tossing on giant blue-green waves during a dark, stormy day. Terrified sailors in ancient Middle Eastern clothing are desperately holding onto ropes. In the centre, a calm but resolute Jonah is being lifted by two sailors to be thrown over the side into the raging waters. Lightning flashes in the dark sky above.

The King of Nineveh, a majestic figure with a beard, stepping down from an ornate stone throne. He has discarded his rich purple and gold royal robes, which lie on the floor, and is wearing rough, brown burlap sackcloth. He sits in a pile of grey ashes, looking upwards with his hands clasped in deep prayer and sorrow. Through an arched window, ordinary citizens and even cattle can be seen wearing similar rough sackcloth.
